SELECT c.id, c.course_name, c.description, c.course_type, c.semester, c.location, c.teacher_id, t.real_name as teacher_name, u.avatar as teacher_avatar, c.assistant_teacher_ids, c.cover_image_url, c.status, c.is_public, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM mg_course c LEFT JOIN mg_teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.sys_user_id = u.id

SELECT c.id, c.course_name, c.description, c.course_type, c.semester, c.location, c.teacher_id, t.real_name as teacher_name, u.avatar as teacher_avatar, c.assistant_teacher_ids, c.cover_image_url, c.status, c.is_public, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM mg_course c LEFT JOIN mg_teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.sys_user_id = u.id

AND t.id IN
#{teacherId}
